# Job names a CI run must contain, all concluded success, before release.yml
# accepts a pull request's run as proof that the root module's tests passed
# (.github/scripts/ci-run-is-full.sh). One name per line; "Test shard" jobs must
# also have run their Test step. Other jobs (extension, account, nosocial,
# wails) may be skipped by the path rules and are ignored.
# ci-run-is-full_test.sh checks this list against the matrix in ci.yml, and
# release.yml reads it from the commit the pull request was merged INTO, so a
# pull request cannot shrink its own proof.
Build & test (default)
Test shard (default r0)
Test shard (default r1)
Test shard (default r2)
Test shard (default r3)
Test shard (default 0)
Test shard (default 1)
Test shard (default 2)
Test shard (default 3)
